The arrow crates of tools/variantjson are the ones the pinned vortex crate is built with: another major is another type, and the tool does not compile (PR 20). They move with the Vortex release, by hand.
A new Vortex release is work to do, not a version to merge. It is never grouped and never automerged. Its label hands it to the agent.
prBodyNotes: This PR only changes `.vortex-version`. CI stays red until the Go implementation follows upstream `{{{currentVersion}}}` to `{{{newVersion}}}`. The procedure is in [docs/upstream-update.md](../blob/main/docs/upstream-update.md).
